# Ticketmaster.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/ticketmaster-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/ticketmaster-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects artist and event data from Ticketmaster.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Ticketmaster in 2026](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-ticketmaster)
- **Code:** [`ticketmaster.py`](ticketmaster.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Artist](results/artist.json) · [Discovery](results/discovery.json)

## What it scrapes

- Ticketmaster artist pages for artist data, ratings, reviews, and events
- Ticketmaster discovery/search pages for event listings with filters

## Functions

- `scrape_artist(urls)` → `List[TicketmasterArtist]`: Scrape Ticketmaster artist pages for artist and event data
- `scrape_discovery(base_url)` → `TicketmasterSearch`: Scrape Ticketmaster discovery API for event listings

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import ticketmaster


async def main():
    artist = await ticketmaster.scrape_artist(
        urls=[
            "https://www.ticketmaster.com/imagine-dragons-tickets/artist/1435919",
            "https://www.ticketmaster.com/george-lopez-tickets/artist/770234",
        ],
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields:

- **`TicketmasterArtist`**: `artist_name`, `ratingValue?`, `bestRating?`, `ratingCount?`, `genre?`, `events_count`, `events`, `reviews`
- **`TicketmasterSearch`**: `events`, `events_count`, `total_count`

A field marked `?` can be `null`.

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`ticketmaster.py`](ticketmaster.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)
- `render_js` = `True`: render the page in a real browser

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/ticketmaster-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_artist_scraping`, `test_discovery_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
